title: Modal Dialogs
description: Open, use and close dialogs drawn in the page, including one that appears by itself on load.

basic.title: Basic modal
basic.modal-body: Close me with the close button, the Escape key or a click outside.
basic.not-closed: The modal has not been closed yet

stacked.title: Stacked modals
stacked.first-body: This modal can open another one on top of it.
stacked.second-body: I am on top of the first modal. Close me to get back to it.

entry.title: Welcome modal
entry.explanation: A welcome modal opens by itself the first time you visit this page and blocks it until it is acknowledged.
entry.modal-body: This modal opened by itself when the page loaded. You need to acknowledge it before you can use the page.
